script_text: Aquarius, this week Uranus — your ruling planet — fires up a shocking alignment that rewrites your trajectory. Monday through Wednesday, Saturn in Scorpio squares your 10th House of career, forcing power struggles at work. Mercury direct in Virgo sharpens your 8th House finances — trust the data, not emotional noise. Wednesday marks the key turning point: Venus enters Gemini, flooding your 5th House of love with romantic energy and creative breakthroughs. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter trines your 11th House of community — networking opens unexpected career doors. The weekend asks you to release control and let Uranus guide surprising opportunities. Thursday is your power day — Jupiter's trine amplifies both career momentum and social connections. Tuesday is your worst day — Saturn's square tests your patience in professional matters. As an Air sign, honest communication is strength — send that difficult conversation you've been avoiding this week. Follow for daily updates.
